answer: One terrace saffron plot per identity locks an 85-credit bond. Harvest leaves only over a bridge weighbridge, which weighs and seals shipments; escrow pays when the bridge record matches the yield. Under one funding key the toll is 38+9(k-1) for the k-th identity, so the 1,000th pays 9,029 and 1,000 fakes pay 4,533,500 plus 85,000 in bonds. Auditors recompute bridge weights and burn bonds on shortfall or reused seals. A rented-terrace ring fails because rented shipments carry the owner's key and mismatch the renter's filing, burning both bonds. An honest grower pays 38 once and recovers it.
